ops.title: P1.5: retire legacy hermes VM-disk build/deploy machinery; consolidate to build-container-image.sh
ops.description: Full dead set + decisions in note 8ddf9e8c. Runs AFTER P1-vault ships (separate logical change). Delete build-hermes-image.sh, build-images.yml (port its genericity guard into build-container-image.sh first), nixos/image.nix, nixos/scratch-login.nix, deploy-vm.sh; edit flake.nix (drop hermes-image/hermes-image-scratch/mkImage, keep hermesModules + nixosConfigurations.hermes), justfile, bootstrap.sh, redeploy.sh, common.nix (strip dead VM-boot if eval survives); CHANGELOG + doc sweep. Nix-correctness verified on the builder VM at P2.

ops.text: No repo reference to build-hermes-image.sh, deploy-vm.sh, hermes-image, nixos.img, or result-hermes outside CHANGELOG/history
build-container-image.sh is the single build path (hermes + vault) and runs the ported secret-leak genericity guard
flake eval + container image build succeed on the builder VM; pytest green
